notes: Hand-written dev bundle (web plan W0.5). ppu 64 + OCR auto_server come from Q3 (outputs/pipeline/qwertz_v1/q3_ocr/summary.json). crop_mode deviates from Q3 'chosen' (key_full): no Q3 row met max_reject_rate 0.10, so run_q3 kept its first stage-2 row instead of the best one; on the same sweep key_center_0.7 scores 0.815 vs 0.613 for key_full at ppu 64 (key_center_0.55: 0.819). key_center_0.7 is preferred over 0.55 because it keeps more of the keycap face, where Thai-English keycaps put the Latin legend near a corner. W1 smoke on 2 Kaggle val images (GT points): correct 23/26 and 14/26 vs 20/26 and 6/26 with key_full. CPU latency is the same for both crops and for rec-only vs auto (~4.4-5.9 s warm for 26 crops while a training job loads the CPU), so auto_server is kept. thresholds = pipeline.yaml q6.default_params with skip_layout_fit true (baseline cannot run the layout fit check).
proxy: Kaggle QWERTZ (OCR/crop settings chosen on Kaggle validation; dev bundle, not a production model)
